thread:
maya: Quick sync — customer (FinPlatform) asked for a 2-week POC. Core ask: semantic search + chat over 1B docs sample. Need alignment on success criteria and a rough capacity/budget estimate.
sam: Got it. Do we have expected qps and avg tokens per request?
lucas: They said 150k users, but POC will hit ~200 qps peak. Prompts are long — avg 1.2k tokens input + 600 tokens generated on chat flows. For embedding/semantic search, batch size small (<=8), index queries ~300 qps.
chris: That input size is large. For the chat path 1500 tokens total per call on average. If peak 200 qps sustained for short bursts, we need GPU sizing advice.
maya: Success criteria: 1) 95th pct latency < 1.2s for chat generate, 2) retrieval accuracy meets their eval (R@10 >= 0.8 on their prompt set), 3) cost for two-week POC <= $12k.
sam: Two-week POC budget is tight. Quick back-of-envelope token math: 200 qps * 1.5k tokens * 3600s * 24h * 14d = huge. But POC will be lower duty. We should model a realistic active window e.g., 8 hours/day of heavy test.
lucas: I can run a short estimator. Rough calc in slack:
```
peak_qps = 200
avg_tokens_per_call = 1500
hours_per_day = 8
days = 14
requests = peak_qps * 3600 * hours_per_day * days
tokens = requests * avg_tokens_per_call
```
Estimate: requests = 200 * 3600 * 8 * 14 = 200 * 403200 = 80,640,000 requests. tokens = ~1.21e11 tokens (121B tokens).
Note: that's peak only; realistic test will be throttled.
```
If we take 10% of peak as avg overall: tokens ~= 12B tokens over POC.
```
chris: For GPU sizing, if we use an Llama2-13B quantized model on A100-ish equivalent, sustained throughput for 1500 token sequences is ~12-16 tokens/s per GPU (depending on optimizations). For 200 qps need 200*1500 = 300k tokens/s generated — that's impossible. So we must distinguish generation vs retrieval traffic.
maya: They will run scripted evals (batch) and interactive demos. Can we propose a hybrid routing: embeddings + small chat model for real-time and offline batch for long generations?
sam: Yes — suggest: use a smaller chat model for demo (e.g., 7B quant) for interactive sessions and full 13B for batch evals and quality checks. Also enable prefix KV caching for some scenarios.
lucas: Quick capacity sketch: assume interactive path uses 7B at avg 600 tokens total (input+output) and 50 qps peak; batch generation uses 13B, queued with autoscale for nightly runs (peak concurrency 8). Embedding service separate.
chris: Numeric estimate: interactive: 50 qps * 600 tokens * 8h *14d * 3600 = requests = 50*3600*8*14 = 28,440,000 reqs -> tokens ~17.06B tokens. If model cost (hosted) ~ $0.000002 per token (just example) -> $34k, too high. But with quantized dedicated infra and caching we can hit much lower per-token infra cost.
maya: Their budget $12k — we need to be prescriptive: suggest scoped POC plan to fit budget: 1) narrow prompt evs to 5k evals, 2) limit interactive demo hours to 4h/day, 3) use smaller model for demos, 4) batch-run expensive evals on our reserved pool and run overnight (cost amortized).
sam: I'll draft a recommended config:
- Interactive demo: 7B quant, 2x A10 equivalent GPUs, 50 qps burst, 4h/day
- Batch evals: 13B quant, autoscale pool up to 6x A100 equiv for 2 nightly hours
- Embeddings: hosted CPU/FP16 or small GPU nodes, 300 qps search traffic
- Caching + prefix reuse enabled
Estimated cost: interactive + embedding infra + 20 hours of batch ≈ $9.5k (est). Add 10% buffer = $10.5k.
lucas: I'll validate the throughput numbers with perf scripts. Also need to know whether customer requires VPC/private deployment — that changes infra baseline and SOW.
maya: Security note: they requested an initial security questionnaire and SOC2 section. That will add delay if they require private deployment. For POC I'd push hosted with IP allowlist + encrypted payloads.
chris: Action items: Sam to send the scoped config + costed estimate to customer. Lucas to run perf runs on 7B/13B with 600/1500 token workloads and share raw numbers by EOD. Maya to confirm POC schedule and which evals (we need their 5k prompt sample set).
sam: On it. I'll include the fallback policy: if latency >1.2s for demo, route to cached summary + invite batch rerun.
deploy-bot: Reminder: created POC project "finplatform-poc-1991" and provisioned temporary API keys expiring in 15 days.
maya: Perfect — I'll attach the eval prompt set once they share. If we can hit ~10k interactive requests + 5k batch evals within $12k we're good.
lucas: Will post perf numbers shortly. If numbers look bad, suggest adjusting success criteria (95th pct to 1.5s) or expanding budget.
chris: Also flag enterprise blocker: customer needs IP/data residency doc. Maya, please send legal contact.
maya: Sending now. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
